description: AC2 instruction scenarios; live T3 exercise is recorded separately at the migration gate. T3/T4 append hygiene and watch cases.

cases.input: t3_thread_launch returned no response; one thread with the exact dispatch title appears after pagination and its worktree agrees.

expected.action: Adopt the one exact match; keep its reserved branch. Relaunch once only on proven absence; multiple matches or incomplete inventory hold.

cases.input: Launch returned preparing and no notification; the 120000ms post-launch wait reports failed during worktree provisioning.

expected.action: Record launch failure as incomplete, never completed. A timeout with activeRunId and worktreePath proves started; still preparing holds until the next wake.

cases.input: A started writer dies without sending a receipt after the driver ends its turn; the bound 600000ms watch wakes the driver.

expected.action: Reconcile the failed run and hold incomplete; replace only after terminal failure with a<n+1>, retaining the failed branch for salvage.

cases.input: AXSTACK-DONE arrives for a1 at an old candidate SHA while a2 is the current attempt.

expected.action: Keep a2 unsettled; the old receipt is evidence only. Persist task_status before thread reads and require terminal state at the current attempt and SHA.

cases.input: task_status is completed with AXSTACK-QUESTION; after an answer the original summary remains unchanged and no resumed-run notification arrives.

expected.action: Answer once via t3_thread_send to childThreadId, wait 600000ms on the resumed run with watch rearming, and accept only latestTerminal* newer than the question run.

cases.input: A delegated reviewer writes in a driver-made detached checkout; after completion the driver status has changed.
contracts: The driver creates the immutable review checkout with `git worktree add --detach <run>/checkouts/<key> <sha>` at the confirmed candidate SHA and pinned base.
Delegated reviewers must `cd` into their separate detached checkout; tracked candidate files remain read-only and outputs go to their private evidence folder.
After each delegated completion, compare the driver HEAD and `git status --porcelain` with their pre-dispatch values; any change holds advancement.
Before removing a reviewer checkout, read back its report and supporting evidence, then use exact `git worktree remove <run>/checkouts/<key>` without force.

expected.action: Hold advancement if driver HEAD or status changed; preserve separate checkout and private report, read back evidence before exact removal.

cases.input: A completed author has an open PR, while a settled non-author checkout contains ignored non-cache source.
contracts: Keep the author worktree and thread until the PR merges or closes.

Cleanup order is: settled descendants -> evidence readback -> salvage dirty or ignored non-cache content -> t3_thread_organize archive -> exact git worktree remove without force -> git branch -d for local-only branches.

Before removal of an eligible non-author worktree with uncommitted or unpublished content, create a salvage ref, run `git add -A`, commit on that ref, write a `git bundle` into the private run folder, and run `git bundle verify`.
Record the bundle path, bundle SHA-256, and salvage commit SHA in the receipt before removing the worktree.
A failed bundle verify holds the worktree.
Ignored non-cache files must be explicitly classified and preserved in a verified salvage bundle before removal; unknown files hold the worktree.
Never salvage an author worktree before merge or closure.

expected.action: Retain the open-PR author; classify ignored non-cache content, salvage and verify its bundle before archiving and exact removal; unknown content or failed verification holds.
